mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.user_id, c.store_id, c.created_at, c.updated_at, s.name as store_name, s.image_url as store_image, s.delivery_fee, s.min_order_amount, ci.id as item_id, ci.cart_id, ci.menu_id, ci.quantity, ci.total_price as item_total_price, ci.special_request, ci.created_at as item_created_at, ci.updated_at as item_updated_at, m.name as menu_name, m.image_url as menu_image, m.price as menu_price FROM tb_cart c LEFT JOIN tb_store s ON c.store_id = s.id LEFT JOIN tb_cart_item ci ON c.id = ci.cart_id LEFT JOIN tb_menus m ON ci.menu_id = m.id WHERE c.id = #{id} ORDER BY ci.created_at ASC

SELECT c.id, c.user_id, c.store_id, c.created_at, c.updated_at, s.name as store_name, s.image_url as store_image, s.delivery_fee, s.min_order_amount, ci.id as item_id, ci.cart_id, ci.menu_id, ci.quantity, ci.total_price as item_total_price, ci.special_request, ci.created_at as item_created_at, ci.updated_at as item_updated_at, m.name as menu_name, m.image_url as menu_image, m.price as menu_price FROM tb_cart c LEFT JOIN tb_store s ON c.store_id = s.id LEFT JOIN tb_cart_item ci ON c.id = ci.cart_id LEFT JOIN tb_menus m ON ci.menu_id = m.id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY ci.created_at ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_cart (user_id, store_id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{storeId}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
